jobs.name: body
jobs.prompt: Pixel art character reference sheet in the style of the attached images (the people in them): a slightly stylised adult villager in plain neutral undershirt and shorts, barefoot, with a smooth closely cropped head (no hairstyle), about 3 heads tall (not a big-headed chibi, not a doll): visible neck, shoulders wider than the head, small dot eyes, a small mouth, hands and feet (not stumps), simple calm everyday look, natural muted warm colors. Four views of the same person in one row, left to right: front, three-quarter front-right, right side, back (no face visible from the back). Same height and the same feet line in all views, arms relaxed at the sides. The image must look like 18x32 pixel sprites enlarged 16 times: crisp square blocks of flat color, all blocks the same size, no anti-aliasing, no blur. Limited palette, hue-shifted shading, light from the top-left. No outline, no shadow on the ground. Fully transparent background, nothing else in the picture.
